name: SVKM's NMIMS School of Business Management (SBM), Mumbai
approvals: SVKM's NMIMS is Deemed to be a University (as per UGC norms)

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA), Mumbai
programs.feeNote: Official handout (NMAT 2026, admission batch 2027) lists the MBA Mumbai fee as INR 13,50,000 per annum for academic year 2026-28 'for information only'; total shown is 2 x per-annum figure. Fee for the 2027 intake (A.Y. 2027-28) will be intimated in the offer letter. Hostel not included. (MBA HR Mumbai: INR 12,75,000 per annum.)
programs.intakeNote: MBA Mumbai seats for the 2025-2026 batch per NMIMS NMAT 2025 admission handout (subject to statutory approvals); 30% of seats offered to female candidates. Not restated in the NMAT 2026 handout.
programs.placementNote: Final Placement Report 2025-26, MBA Core 2024-26: average CTC INR 24.6 lakh; highest INR 41.28 lakh; 190 recruiters; 28% of batch placed through PPOs. Median not published. MBA HR 2024-26 average INR 19.08 lakh. No audit stated.

selectionProcess.name: NMAT by GMAC test + NMIMS registration
selectionProcess.detail: NMAT by GMAC mandatory; candidate must also register on the NMIMS portal before the NMAT test date and give at least five programme preferences. Only the first NMAT attempt is considered.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on NMAT sectional and total scores
selectionProcess.detail: Shortlisted candidates called for an in-person second stage.

selectionProcess.name: Competency Test and/or Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: In-person; details announced to shortlisted candidates.

selectionProcess.name: Final merit list
selectionProcess.detail: Based on NMAT score, PI, Competency Test, work experience (more than one year gets weightage) and past academic performance; allotment by merit, preferences and seat availability. Weights not published; cut-offs at NMIMS's discretion.

keyDates.notes: NMIMS application window for the 2027 batch (NMAT 2026) per admission handout; NMIMS registration must be completed before the candidate's NMAT test date. Application fee INR 3,000. Second-stage, merit-list and fee-payment dates to be declared later.

nirf.note: Ranked entity is SVKM's Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (the university), not SBM Mumbai alone.
